purpose: Resolve existing public-client capability, editor-front-window origin and ordinary session metadata without returning or reading token/identity fields
limitations: Editor-origin evidence cannot become a published-app CORS binding
No cryptographic JWT/issuer/claim or map endpoint acceptance
No exact installed plugin release number is exposed by this check
SDK getSession may refresh the existing Auth session; its internal read is not abortable at the diagnostic deadline

installationArgs.name: Market Intel session capabilities (review)
installationArgs.description: Manually invoked editor-only diagnostic. Static statuses, booleans and exact rendered origin only. No identity/token access, app API calls, persistence, sign-in/out, map grants, provider or feature changes. getSession may refresh the existing Auth session.

inspect.name: Check existing public session capabilities
inspect.__wwdescription: Check the existing legacy public client with one bounded SDK read and one temporary subscription; return only safe metadata and clean up once.

executionPlan: Verify the new function name/ID is absent before installing; never replace an existing workflow
Install only the reviewed function in Investscape Dev, without attaching a page/app/element trigger
Manually run once in the editor against any already available Dev session; report NO_SESSION if absent, without creating an account or issuing a sign-in request
Record only returned static status/booleans/origin and whether subscriptionReleased is true
No automatic retry, sign-out/account switch, map API request, save/cleanup workflow or publication
Keep live grants, NOLOGIN roles, origin bindings and map flags unchanged
laterAcceptance: Real map transport/server acceptance still requires separately approved candidate target/bindings and member access; this diagnostic does not appoint an administrator or authorize a member

authorization.instruction: Continue installed WeWeb/accessor, exact app origin and real-session compatibility work
authorization.scopeInterpretation: One reversible manually invoked Dev capability diagnostic is necessary to perform the requested session compatibility verification; no automatic trigger, new account/sign-in, map endpoint or publication is authorized
